name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.3: complaint mail goes to the operator contact email only, and silent failures now surface. The old recipient chain fell back to whichever user held operator_admin when no contact email was set, which routed a food-safety complaint to a refiller. That fallback is removed: the operator contactEmail is the single recipient, and if it is unset the complaint raises a warning alert naming the operator instead of guessing at a person. Separately, a rejected send (for example a suspended email plan) now raises an email-delivery-failing alert, deduped daily, so a dead mail pipeline appears in the dashboard rather than only in server logs. Cumulative over v6.2.
